subject: A Petition for the Development of Unmanaged Visual Basic and Visual Basic for Applications (classicvb.org petition page)
creator: classicvb.org (site copyright holder per its own 2005 footer). The petition text is described on the classicvb.org home page as a request 'originating with the Microsoft MVPs'; no individual author is named on the pictured page, and none is asserted here.
title: Petition to Microsoft

archive.name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine
archive.captures_listed_in_banner: 490 captures, 9 Mar 2005 - 9 Sep 2026 (as displayed on access date)

original_publication_date: unknown (page self-reports the petition running 'since March 8th, 2005'; the exact publication date of this page version is unknown)
depicted_event_date: Petition campaign launched 2005-03-08 per the page's own text; press coverage dated 8-10 March 2005 is listed on the archived classicvb.org home page
access_method: Anonymous, unauthenticated HTTP GET of a public Wayback Machine replay via headless Chromium (Playwright). No account, login, CAPTCHA, form submission, or terms acceptance. The petition's 'Sign' links were not followed.
version_evidence: Wayback banner in source/original.png shows MAR 12 2005 and the original URL http://classicvb.org/petition/.
Raw archived HTML (source/archived-html/petition_20050312064351.html) matches the CDX SHA-1 digest for that timestamp.
The page's own counter reads '1376 signatories including 203 Microsoft MVPs since March 8th, 2005.' This is a self-reported figure at capture time, not independently verified.
replay_substitutions: styles.css served from Wayback capture 20050313060842 (nearest available; Wayback redirect).
images/digital-signing.gif served from Wayback capture 20050518021902 (nearest available; Wayback redirect).

original_dimensions.note: Full-page Chromium screenshot at 1280x720 CSS viewport, device scale factor 1.5 (CSS page size 1280x1638). The page is HTML; there is no native image original, so the uncropped screenshot including the Wayback banner is the preserved original capture.

transformations.operation: Pixel-exact crop of source/original.png, box (0,0,1920,1080). No resampling, scaling, stretching, retouching, blur or overlays.
transformations.keeps: Wayback banner with MAR 12 2005 date and original URL; petition heading; intro; objectives 1-2 and the heading of objective 3.
transformations.omits: Rest of the page below y=1080: remainder of objective 3, suggested approach, conclusion, the self-reported signature counter, 'Sign the petition' artwork, and the email-verification note. Nothing that contradicts the date/version is removed.

transformations.operation: Uniform Lanczos downscale of the editorial frame to 1280x720 (review proof only).
Uniform Lanczos downscale of the whole original to 563x720 (review proof only).

personal_data: No individual signatory names appear on this page version (names were on separate linked pages that were not captured). No blurring or omission of names was needed. The earlier 2005-03-09 capture (inspected only, not kept in the repository; sha256 fb106eb70d24c955819c0fbd5e61ecfd239f90f499d2e1d49df40b351b0041d7) contains an inline list of 247 names with personal websites; it is not pictured or vendored.
